Container.Name: GitPreserver
Container.Overview:
A life preserver for your git repositories. Mirror-clones all repos with full branch and tag history, exports issues/PRs/releases as JSON, and (optionally) syncs encrypted backups to Backblaze B2, AWS S3, Google Drive, OneDrive, MEGA, SMB, or any rclone-supported destination.
GitPreserver runs as a one-shot batch job. Start the container to run a backup; the container exits when finished. To run on a schedule, use the User Scripts plugin to invoke `docker start GitPreserver` on a cron expression. See the project README for full setup.

Config.Name: Personal Access Token
Config.Description: GitHub Personal Access Token. Fine-grained (github_pat_...) is recommended — see the project README for the exact least-privilege permissions.

Config.Name: Username or Org
Config.Description: GitHub username or organization name to back up.

Config.Name: Backup Path
Config.Description: Host path where dated backup snapshots are written. Each run creates a YYYY-MM-DD subdirectory containing repos/ and metadata/.

Config.Name: rclone Remote
Config.Description: rclone remote name (e.g. b2-remote). Must exist in rclone.conf below. Leave blank for local-only backup.

Config.Name: rclone Bucket / Path
Config.Description: Path or bucket on the rclone remote to sync into.

Config.Name: rclone Config File
Config.Description: Host path to your rclone.conf. Mounted read-only. Only required when an rclone remote is configured above.

Config.Name: Enable Encryption
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to encrypt backups via rclone crypt. Requires the Crypt Remote below to be configured in rclone.conf.

Config.Name: Crypt Remote
Config.Description: Name of an rclone crypt remote that wraps your storage remote. Required when Enable Encryption is true.

Config.Name: Retention Days
Config.Description: Delete local dated snapshot directories older than this many days. Set to 0 to keep forever.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Host user ID for file ownership. unRAID's default 'nobody' user is UID 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Host group ID for file ownership. unRAID's default 'users' group is GID 100.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for backup files.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity passed to rclone: debug | info | warn | error

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to test without writing repos or syncing. Useful for verifying credentials and paths the first time.
